feeds.title: MINT DC Blog
feeds.description: Locally founded, owned, and operated since 2006, MINT offers a healthy retreat to achieve your wellness goals. With a fully equipped health club, six focused fitness studios, outdoor classes, community events, and DC's most talented fitness instructors and personal trainers, you will find that your health and wellness journey just got a little more fun. Get into their blog and learn more about memberships, personal training, classes, schedules, and more.

feeds.title: DC Health
feeds.description: The DC Department of Health promotes health, wellness, and equality across DC and protects the safety of residents, visitors, and those doing business here. The purpose of the group is to evaluate the District's progress towards meeting the requirements of the transparency, open government, and open data directive, and make specific recommendations for improvements. Go through their blog and learn more about health and wellness.

feeds.title: Whitman-Walker Blog
feeds.description: For over fifty years, Whitman-Walker has been part of the fabric of the local DC and national community as a first responder and care provider for those living with HIV. It envisions a society where all people are seen for who they are, treated with dignity and respect, and afforded equal opportunity to health and wellbeing. Get into their blog and learn more about their services, treatments, events, careers, research studies, and more.

feeds.title: A Fresh Start Therapy Blog
feeds.description: A Fresh Start Therapy is a minority, locally-owned behavioral and mental health therapy practice located in Washington, D.C. They collaborate with their clients to impact change, allowing them to live healthy lives. From work-based problems to past traumatic experiences, their staff is highly trained, solutions-oriented, empathic, and responsive to their clients, enabling them to leave their care feeling better. Go through their blog and learn more about their services, holistic and behavioral therapies, informational articles, and more regarding mental health and wellness.

feeds.title: Ancestral Nutrition
feeds.description: Saying goodbye to fad diets and synthetic food trends? Head on to Ancestral Nutrition to get a hold of recipes, meal plans, and tips on how to lose weight and eat healthy at the same time. Founder Danielle Andrews, who is a certified nutrition consultant, believes in only eating wholesome and unprocessed foods like what our ancestors used to eat during their time.
